purpose: Source-first evaluation of mathematical statements, bounded physical interfaces, and experimental claims
root_rule: Ad(x) implies C_J(x): admissible reapplication carries its owning jurisdiction and constraint.

authority_levels.exact_theorem: Check the hypotheses and proof within the stated mathematical structure.
authority_levels.finite_computation: Check source, implementation, inputs, and deterministic receipt.
authority_levels.bounded_interface: Check exactly which structures are mapped, preserved, imported, and left open.
authority_levels.physical_model: Check governing equation, physical parameters, calibration, scale, and measured observable.
authority_levels.empirical_claim: Check units, methods, data, uncertainty, independent replication, and predictive scope.
authority_levels.open_dependency: Preserve the outstanding obligation as a typed dependency until a subsequent version supplies verification.

inference_policy.positive_typing: Report what each claim establishes and the jurisdiction in which it establishes it.
inference_policy.no_strength_inflation: A mathematical identity does not itself certify a physical identification or measured fundamental constant.
inference_policy.no_strength_drop: Do not downgrade a valid mathematical proof merely because a distinct physical inference is unresolved.
inference_policy.source_precedence: Versioned manuscripts, exact proofs, computational inputs, receipts, and explicit correction records govern summaries.
inference_policy.edition_boundary: Each claim remains bound to its named source edition. A successor edition receives its own status after its source, proof location, and verification receipt are inspected.
inference_policy.critique_rule: When identifying a gap, name the specific claimed proposition, required dependency, and evidence present or missing.

versioning: Public edits are append-only at the claim level: superseded assertions retain provenance and a linked correction.
required_fields_apply_to: CoppaliniArchitectureClaimRegistry.claims[]; the other source schemas retain the field mappings below.

archived_claim_registry.role: Claim-level records in the archived R28 preparation snapshot; each status keeps its stated source edition.

exact_reader_registry.role: Source-indexed calculation and model records in their declared jurisdictions.

four_dual_forms_registry.role: Claim-level records for the named v0.3 source set.

released_artifact_registry.role: Released artifact inventory; result and scope remain the exact statements of each artifact record.

record_identity: Resolve an identifier together with its source registry URL and source version. Preserve the meaning of each source field when mapping schemas.

receipt_taxonomy.expected_output: The declared target used to check a calculation. It is available before execution and keeps its own label.
receipt_taxonomy.recorded_result: A saved execution result or receipt bound to its named source, implementation, inputs, and stated scope.
receipt_taxonomy.current_execution: The result produced by the present run on its identified inputs and loaded implementation, with the observed run status.
receipt_taxonomy.classification_rule: Classify evidence by the operation it records. A registry link can identify expected output or a saved receipt; the current run supplies its own execution result.
